e.deleted = 0
AND (e.estimation_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR e.instock_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR e.invoice_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
AND e.supplier_id = #{q.supplierId} AND e.status = #{q.status} AND e.period = #{q.period}

SELECT e.supplier_id, s.name AS supplier_name, COUNT(*) AS estimation_count, SUM(e.amount) AS total_amount, SUM(e.reversed_amount) AS reversed_amount, SUM(e.amount - e.reversed_amount) AS open_amount FROM pur_estimation e LEFT JOIN base_supplier s ON s.id = e.supplier_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND e.period = #{period} GROUP BY e.supplier_id, s.name ORDER BY open_amount DESC, e.supplier_id
